definition.failure: stop on reserved missing-return; no hidden retry; engineering recovery logged without extra forwards
definition.matching: eight pairs selected from input geometry only; observational TRAIN/DEV comparison not causal generalization estimate
definition.model: EXP67 completed step6000, one fixed generator
definition.noise: two original DEV seeds; exact MT19937 free-prefix pairing; same complete free noise for sub4
definition.quality: unchanged full old quality CF FF I, AVMR PMR all thresholds, legal shared edges; no selecting favorable metrics
definition.query: same physical2048 points and weights for base/sub4, point ownership remapped, normals/borders recomputed; vertex-based AVMR denominator changes and is not retess-invariant
definition.sampling: Euler50 BF16 forward FP32 integration, all RAW then single D0 GEO_C source-winding export
definition.subdivision: two earliest eligible matched pairs, HALF and FULL; each C face split4; N increases by3K with same free count; operational representation sensitivity not isolated token-attention causality
definition.visual_review: all RAW/POST; blue C/gray F; full views plus local side views; YES/NO/UNCERTAIN with notes; nonblind AI_PROXY
